jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Xiper is a travel tech platform for hospitality industry. Please visit our wewwbsite and do your research before applying \- xipper.in

**Experience:** 2\+ years  
**Location:** Remote  
**Type:** Full\-time

What we need

* 2\+ years of **production\-level AI/ML engineering experience**.
* Strong hands\-on **Python** development — not just prompt engineering or ChatGPT/API integration.
* Proven experience building and deploying **AI automation and agentic workflows**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Voice AI** — STT, TTS, voice agents, call automation and real\-time conversational systems.
* Experience building **AI pipelines that connect multiple systems, APIs, databases and business workflows**.
* Ability to build AI agents that can **reason, make decisions, call tools/APIs and execute workflows**.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and model/API orchestration.
* Experience with **LangChain / LangGraph / CrewAI / similar frameworks** is preferred.
* Experience training, fine\-tuning or evaluating ML/AI models is a plus.
* Strong understanding of **APIs, webhooks, queues, databases and asynchronous workflows**.
* Experience deploying AI systems in production using **AWS/Azure, Docker and CI/CD**.
* Ability to design an **AI intelligence layer across multiple products and data sources**.

What you will build at Xipper

* AI\-powered hotel operations and workflow automation.
* Voice AI for guests, hotels and internal teams.
* AI agents connected to PMS, OTA, CRM, payments and hotel workflows.
* AI revenue management, forecasting and decision systems.
* Automated guest communication and support.
* Intelligent lead, booking and operations workflows.
* A central **AI intelligence layer across the entire Xipper ecosystem**.

Must Have

**Show us what you have built.**

Applications without **actual deployed AI/Voice AI projects, GitHub/code samples, live demos or production work samples will not be considered.**

We are looking for an **AI engineer who builds systems**, not someone who only knows how to write prompts.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
GWC DATA.AI is looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** with strong hands\-on experience in **AI/ML, Generative AI, and LLM\-based applications**.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop AI/ML and GenAI solutions for real\-world use cases.
* Build **LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and chatbots**.
* Work with **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex** or similar frameworks.
* Develop, integrate, deploy, and optimize AI models and APIs.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
* Mentor junior AI engineers and contribute to technical decisions.

**Required Skills:**

* 4\+ years of experience in **AI/ML Engineering**.
* Strong **Python** and Machine Learning fundamentals.
* Hands\-on experience with **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering**.
* Experience with **PyTorch/TensorFlow, REST APIs, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)**.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

**Good to Have:** Experience in **Agentic AI, LLMOps/MLOps, fine\-tuning, and multimodal AI**.

Pay: ₹1,078,831\.62 \- ₹1,567,492\.15 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* AI: 3 years (Preferred)
* LLM: 3 years (Preferred)
* GEN AI: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: generative AI
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate and enthusiastic **Generative AI Intern** who is eager to explore cutting\-edge AI technologies, build intelligent applications, and work on real\-world projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop AI\-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Design and optimize prompts for various AI use cases.
* Work with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or other Generative AI models.
* Build AI chatbots, assistants, and automation workflows.
* Integrate AI APIs into web and mobile applications.
* Assist in Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) implementation.
* Collaborate with development teams to deliver AI\-based client solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI technologies.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of Python programming.
* Knowledge of Generative AI concepts and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Familiarity with Prompt Engineering.
* Understanding of REST APIs and API integrations.
* Basic knowledge of Machine Learning fundamentals.
* Knowledge of LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases, or RAG is a plus
* Eagerness to learn and adapt to new AI technologies.

What You'll Gain

* Hands\-on experience working on live client projects.
* Mentorship from experienced AI professionals.
* Exposure to modern AI frameworks and tools.
* Opportunity to build an industry\-ready portfolio.
* Practical experience with Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, LLMs, and AI integrations.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion.
* Outstanding performers may receive a **Pre\-Placement Offer (PPO)** or full\-time employment opportunity at Bexo.ai.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
